integration.name: Vertical Integration
integration.description: Degree to which the company owns or controls farmland and can mandate agronomic practices

scores.1: Minimal integration; sources from independent growers only
scores.2: Some contract farming but no owned land
scores.3: Owns some farmland; mix of owned and contracted supply
scores.4: Significant owned farmland with centralised agronomy decisions
scores.5: Fully integrated; owns/controls majority of farmland, can mandate practices across operations

high_value_crop.name: High-Value Crop Exposure
high_value_crop.description: Value-at-stake based on the economics of the company's primary crops

scores.0: No relevant crops (e.g., animal feed only)
scores.1: Low-value commodity crops with thin margins
scores.2: Mix of commodity and moderate-value crops
scores.5: Premium high-value crops with strong ROI case for biostimulants (e.g., table grapes, blueberries)

registration_ease.name: Registration Ease
registration_ease.description: Ease of EU regulatory pathway for Stimblue+ in the company's primary markets

scores.0: Markets with no biostimulant regulatory framework
scores.1: Complex registration in all primary markets
scores.2: Mixed; some markets easy, others difficult
scores.3: Moderate registration complexity; established pathways exist
scores.4: Straightforward registration in most markets; EU-aligned
scores.5: EU-based or EU-aligned markets with clear biostimulant regulation

scale_potential.name: Scale Potential
scale_potential.description: Size of the company's farming footprint and degree of centralisation

scores.0: No meaningful scale (<100 ha or equivalent)
scores.4: Large footprint (20,000-100,000 ha) with centralised procurement
scores.5: Very large footprint (>100,000 ha) with highly centralised decision-making

strategic_leverage.name: Strategic Leverage
strategic_leverage.description: Brand value and reference potential for Kelp Blue's commercial credibility

scores.1: Known locally but limited international recognition
scores.3: Well-known national brand with industry presence
scores.4: Major international brand; strong reference value
scores.5: Global household name; partnership would be transformative for credibility

penalty_complexity.name: Procurement Complexity Penalty
penalty_complexity.description: Penalty for overly complex procurement structures that slow adoption

scores.-1: Moderately complex; regional procurement committees or multi-layer approvals
scores.-2: Highly complex; fragmented procurement across many subsidiaries or co-ops
